tools.name: status
tools.description: Check Threadgehog availability, account linking, your projects and available tools.

tools.name: read_posts
tools.description: Read public Threads posts as author voice examples. X links cannot be read; paste their text instead.

tools.name: get_writing_brief
tools.description: Get platform limits, writing rules and a voice guide to fill in, before writing new drafts. Not needed to read posts or build a voice guide from them: read_posts already returns the voice guide fields.

tools.name: score_drafts
tools.description: Score up to ten drafts against your writing rules without saving them.

tools.name: save_drafts
tools.description: Save drafts you wrote to the linked Threadgehog account as pending posts, so they can be reviewed and queued.

tools.name: approve_drafts
tools.description: Approve saved drafts and send them to the user's linked scheduler, which publishes them on its schedule. Ask the user to confirm first.

tools.name: reject_drafts
tools.description: Reject saved drafts. Rejected drafts are not posted and cannot be approved later.

tools.name: edit_draft
tools.description: Replace the text of one saved draft that is still pending or failed. One string per post in a thread. The old text is not kept, so confirm with the user first.

tools.name: list_queue
tools.description: List the approved and scheduled posts of one project.

tools.name: send_post_now
tools.description: Send one queued post to the user's linked scheduler to publish about two minutes from now. Ask the user to confirm first.

tools.name: insights
tools.description: Show how recent posts performed: views, replies, follows and top performers.

tools.name: show_account
tools.description: Read-only. Lists the user's projects (their ids are the projectId for list_queue, send_post_now and insights), the linked scheduler accounts and channels, and returns a one-time link, valid 15 minutes, to the Threadgehog account page where scheduler keys are entered.

tools.name: delete_linked_account
tools.description: Permanently delete this Threadgehog link and its data: drafts, projects, scheduler keys and sign-in tokens. Cannot be undone. Ask the user to confirm first.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "claude" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_posts, get_writing_brief, list_queue · Private data: delete_linked_account · Public sink: approve_drafts, edit_draft, send_post_now · Destructive: delete_linked_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_posts, get_writing_brief, list_queue · Private data: delete_linked_account · Public sink: approve_drafts, edit_draft, send_post_now · Destructive: delete_linked_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
